name: DepthSplat
plain: DepthSplat (ETH Zurich / cvg): 3D Gaussian splats and depth from several posed images in one pass; saves a 3DGS .ply. MIT (Small checkpoint).
summary: DepthSplat (Xu et al. 2025): feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting and depth from posed, calibrated images. A multi-view cost volume (UniMatch transformer, 2D U-Net) fused with a monocular DINOv2 ViT-S predicts every view's depth; a DPT feature upsampler and a Gaussian head predict one Gaussian per pixel (opacity, scale, rotation, degree-2 SH) in the given world frame (`result.gaussians`, `.save("scene.ply")`). Forward pass only: no renderer.

papers.title: DepthSplat: Connecting Gaussian Splatting and Depth

licence_notes: Only the Small RealEstate10K checkpoint is shipped: MIT code and weights, its monocular branch initialised from Depth Anything V2 Small (Apache-2.0). The Base / Large checkpoints build on Depth Anything V2 Base / Large (CC-BY-NC-4.0) and are not offered.
task_io: Input: several images of one scene (posed and calibrated for multi-view stereo, unposed otherwise). Output: depth maps and, where the model predicts them, cameras and 3-D points.

variants.name: depthsplat-small-re10k

training_data.name: RealEstate10K (camera trajectories of YouTube real-estate videos)

licence.training_note: RealEstate10K (YouTube videos, camera poses from ORB-SLAM; research use per its release), from a UniMatch depth / Depth Anything V2 Small initialisation.

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
original16.note: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); cvg/depthsplat@2dad25a7b9ba EncoderDepthSplat, long side 256

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

kernels.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

quality.title: DTU scans 1, 9, 24, 33, 75, view 24 + 7 sources, AbsRel / delta1 %
quality.protocol: 640x512 crops, the 7 most co-visible views as sources; GT = depth rendered from the structured-light points. AbsRel / delta1 over GT pixels, after per-image median scaling unless the model takes the cameras (calibrated MVS: cameras, error in mm; PatchMatchNet also the depth range 425-935 mm, MVSAnywhere its own range from the camera baselines).

original16.note: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); cvg/depthsplat@2dad25a7b9ba EncoderDepthSplat, long side 256

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 1.6e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.0035 and p99 <= 0.017 (absolute error of the output `depth`).
